items.html: And the explanation of the secret of the "clothing" (Kesut) indicates that the world of Yetzira has a garment and covering from another world that covers it, namely the world of Assiya, which covers the world of Yetzira, as is known: for every lower one is called the cover of the upper one; and likewise Yetzira covers Beria, and the like. And the secret of this quantity is in the deficiency of the vessels of Assiya, and not in the aspect of the essentiality (Atzmut).
